fields.label: Home address
fields.help: Where trips start, and where the children are brought from. Street, number and town.

fields.label: Calendars to follow
fields.help: One .ics link per calendar, like Work|https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/.../basic.ics. The name before the | is the calendar's name; the planner asks once whose calendar it is.

fields.label: How you travel
fields.help: For the time to leave. By car, parking time is added.

fields.label: Minutes early
fields.help: How early you want to be somewhere. 10 by default.

fields.label: Warn before leaving (minutes)
fields.help: How long before the time to leave Iris tells you. 15 by default.

fields.label: Day starts
fields.help: Like 08:00. Breaks and meals are planned inside the day.

fields.label: Lunch
fields.help: Like 12:30, or empty for none. It moves to the nearest free half hour.

fields.label: Break after (minutes busy)
fields.help: After this long without a gap, a break is planned. 120 by default.

fields.label: Ask how it went after
fields.help: Words in the title of appointments to ask about afterwards, like client, 1:1, interview.
